STAGE: scope check + design-space deconfliction (ideation_4)

GOAL: pick one coupling position that is (a) inside the scope contract, (b) not one of the three already-tried mechanisms, (c) precision-first at the deepest level only.

READ: the round brief (chain behaviour graph -> tree distance -> Gromov delta -> hyperbolic curvature -> hyperbolic RQ-VAE -> SID -> Stage3 -> recall@10) and the three rejected/selected proposals listed for rounds 20261028/29/31:
 - poincare-frechet-successor-codebook: successor-weighted Frechet codebook UPDATES (acts on codebook vectors during training).
 - CURVCTRL-SID: per-LEVEL curvature set from measured hard prefix-transition score (acts on level-wise curvature scalars).
 - BRad-RQ: behaviour-ranked RADIAL Poincare assignment, per-item curvature from context entropy (acts on the radius/rank order of assignment).

OBSERVED / REASONING: all three occupy (i) codebook updates, (ii) per-level curvature scalars, (iii) radial ordering. The unoccupied corner is the IDEAL BOUNDARY: horospheres / Busemann functions, which exist only in negative curvature and are neither radial ranking nor a curvature scalar nor a codebook mean. Also unoccupied: a post-Stage-2, deepest-level-only move set gated by a constant-free "does the frozen prefix-to-child geometry still support this token" test. The round brief explicitly demands an extra sufficiency condition beyond the admissibility certificate; a sign-of-a-difference geodesic surprisal test (Delta <= 0) is the only candidate condition with literally no tunable constant.

DECISION: HORO-TRANSPLANT-L. Levels 1..L-1 bit-identical; only k_L moves; behaviour supplies the successor cell b(i) and the horosphere height h; the Poincare Busemann function supplies the membership test D_i; the frozen child-anchor geodesic distance supplies the sufficiency gate Delta_i. Removing behaviour => zero candidates => zero moves. Removing curvature => half-space instead of horoball and Euclidean instead of geodesic => different accept set.

OPEN: nothing blocking; writing the full block next.

STAGE: final answer (ideation_4, record 2 of 2)

GOAL: deliver the single in-scope proposal on the behaviour x hyperbolic coupling chain.
READ: no new files; this record carries the complete block as the last record.
RESULT (summary): HORO-TRANSPLANT-L. After Stage 2 is frozen, only level L changes (levels 1..L-1 bit-identical). Behaviour = training-split directed transition counts M[i,j] over consecutive pairs, deduplicated per user, popularity-normalised into sibling-cell flow Wbar[k->j]. Geometry = Poincare ball (K=-1) with data-derived injection scale s, Frechet child anchors m_{p,k} (8 fixed Riemannian steps), ideal boundary points xi_{p,k}, Busemann height B_{p,k}(x)=log((1-|x|^2)/(2|x-xi|^2)). Coupling: destination child b(i) from behaviour affinity, height h_{p,k} = median of B over b's behaviour-reachable set, horoball test D_i = B_{p,b}(x_i) - h_{p,b} >= 0. The extra precision condition beyond the two-sided structural certificate (split: cell keeps >=2 members and i is not a cut vertex of the within-cell 1-NN behaviour graph; merge: target code pre-exists and no code is emptied) is Delta_i = d_H(x_i,m_{p,b})^2 - d_H(x_i,m_{p,a})^2 <= 0: a constant-free sign test saying the frozen prefix-to-child geometry must still reach the new token at least as easily. Justified from the frozen Stage-2 code vectors by isometry, not from a tuned constant. One synchronous pass, no iteration (no stopping constant).
COST: zero added training flops (72000 Stage-2 steps unchanged; Stage-3 150 epochs unchanged); one offline pass ~4e8 multiply-adds, under a CPU-minute.
DIAGNOSTICS REPORTED, NOT GATED: moved fraction; validation L1 negative hit rate before/after (predicted bit-identical because k_1 is untouched, so it is the regression guard against the previous round's one-third-catalogue churn); per-item deepest-code conditional entropy before/after.
REASONING: this occupies the ideal-boundary corner, which none of the three earlier mechanisms (Frechet codebook updates, per-level curvature scalar, radial behaviour-ranked assignment) touched, and it is the only design in which the required "additional sufficiency condition" is the exact sign of a measured difference.
OPEN: none. Frozen judgement remains Stage-3 test_recall@10 > 0.065, one run, no ablations trained.
